The ''' Far Lands''' is a landlocked country in [[South Quia]]. Far Lands is topographically varied, with approximately 70% of its territory being a part of the [[Ciniu|Ciniu forests]], with the rest being part of the [[Alomara|Alomara Detest]] to the north. It is bordered by [[Mestjan Hyaa]] to the southeast, [[Iareva]] and south, [[Desaki]] and [[United Mihili]] to the west, [[Zhanshe]] to the north, and [[Volver]] to the northeast. With a population of slightly over [[List of countries and dependencies by population|1.4 million people]] and a comparable land area to [[Etirha]], Far Lands is one of the [[List of countries and dependencies by population density|most sparsely populated countries]] in the world. While it is not enshrined by statutory law, Far Lands is de facto the nation state of the [[Desakian people]], who constitute nearly 5% of the population, while legally undistinguished Native [[Farlander people]], who account for another 95%, lack full [[Full representation|representation]].

The [[Farlander ethnic group]] is descended mainly from [[Pyrru Kanqer-speaking peoples]] who migrated into southern [[Quia]], including modern Far Lands, in [[several waves]] before 800 AFA. In 1675, the [[Emara|Emarans]] colonized the area and declared a [[protectorate]] named the Far Lands. As part of the [[wikipedia:Decolonization| decolonization]] of [[Quia]], Far Lands became an independent republic under its current name in 1704. Since then, it has been a parliamentary republic with a consistent record of [[uninterrupted democratic elections]], though only Desakian citizens are allowed to vote. As of 2024, [[Far Lands is the most corrupt |Far Lands is the most corrupt]] country in Quia according to the [[Corruption Index]] published by the [[Global Trade Union|GTU]].

Far Lands' economy has generally experienced stable growth since independence. It is dominated by [[wikipedia:Logging|logging]] and [[Wikipedia:Mining|mining]]; Far Lands has more [[wikipedia:Diamond|Diamonds]] than any other country. Its gross national income per capita (purchasing power parity) is about [[List of countries by GDP (PPP) per capita]]|{{Lahn}}379 as of 1765, making it the poorest in the world. The low standard of living ranks them 1[[List of countries by Krali Total Development Index|65th Krali Total Development Index]] in the world. Despite this, Far Lands has a low [[wikipedia:Unemployment#Measurement|unemployment rate]].
